title: Tell the truth like a child under mercy
summary: The child does not hide the mistake; it tells the truth under the Father's mercy. Let confession stay near trust, not self-defense.
takeaway: Tell the truth from inside the Father's mercy.
lifeApplication: After a miss, name it plainly in ardaas before explaining yourself to anyone else.

source.shortMeaning: The soul admits its mistakes like a child because the Lord remains Father and Mother.
source.lifeApplication: Let the first movement after failure be confession under care, not argument.

evidence.coreClaim: The soul can confess failure without collapse because the Lord remains Father and Mother.
evidence.turn: Mistakes are brought into mercy instead of hidden behind self-protection.
evidence.practicalImplication: After a miss, name it plainly in ardaas before explaining yourself to anyone else.
